nodes.community_name: internal/config — JSONC config parsing, defaults, validation
nodes.norm_label: readsse — sse reader with stall timeout
nodes.rationale: Returns ErrStall after 90s with no data (the caller cancels the request so the body read unblocks); CRLF, missing space after 'data:', multi-line data, comment lines and blank keep-alives must parse identically; a clean end without the terminal event becomes io.ErrUnexpectedEOF so a proxy closing mid-response never reads as success.

nodes.label: Registry — config → (Model, Adapter)
nodes.community_name: internal/config — JSONC config parsing, defaults, validation
nodes.rationale: URL precedence baseUrls[protocol] > baseUrl > built-in default; config model overrides merge with catalog entries rather than replace; cfg.Model/ModelHard validated at construction; credentials resolved lazily so a missing env key fails at request time, not at startup.

nodes.label: ResolveEnv — env: indirection
nodes.community_name: internal/config — JSONC config parsing, defaults, validation

nodes.label: retryable — error classification
nodes.community_name: internal/config — JSONC config parsing, defaults, validation
nodes.rationale: 429/5xx/anthropic 529/stall/connection reset are retried; other 4xx, context overflow and cancellation are not; review added io.EOF, HTTP 408, ECONNREFUSED/EPIPE/ECONNABORTED and HTTP/2 GOAWAY as retryable, with retry-after capped at 60s.

nodes.community_name: internal/config — JSONC config parsing, defaults, validation

nodes.label: Standardize — string-literal-aware JSONC pre-pass
nodes.community_name: internal/config — JSONC config parsing, defaults, validation
nodes.rationale: Comments and trailing commas are replaced by spaces preserving byte length and line structure so decode-error offsets still point at the right line:col; string literals (escapes honoured) are never touched.
